why: align F4 -- a stack fact reads the development section outside package.json, a gate does not. mcp in [tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies] is mcp-server evidence, because a repository declaring the MCP SDK as a development dependency is still an MCP server. fastapi sits in the SAME group and must NOT open q1_backend (trap 4): a framework present only to drive tooling does not make this repository run a service, so api-design must not arrive. Both halves live in one tree deliberately: the two readers are shared between the stack facts and the gate, so a fixture asserting only the firing half would stay green against a change that widened the GATE as well
